description: A React functional component named TimingSection that displays timing and performance information for a workflow node, including start/end times, durations, and live elapsed time. It uses imported UI components and utility functions.

methods.name: TimingSection
methods.description: React component that renders timing and performance details for a workflow node based on its props.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Helper function to format duration given in milliseconds into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Helper function to convert a timestamp string into a formatted date and time object.

methods.name: getElapsedTime
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time from node start to now or completion.
